story.text: The White Rabbit sends Alice to his {HOUSE} to fetch his fan and gloves. There she drinks from another little bottle, and grows so big that she must put one arm out of the {WINDOW} and one foot up the {CHIMNEY}. Outside, the Rabbit orders Bill the Lizard to climb down. Alice {KICKS}, and up goes {BILL} like a {SKYROCKET}!
story.caption: Up goes Bill like a sky-rocket
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
